Daily Briefing — Tuesday, June 16 2026

AI leaders call for synthetic DNA regulation as governance gaps widen in enterprise deployments

AI & Technology

#1 — OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, and Microsoft CEOs Call for Synthetic DNA Screening Legislation — MobiHealthNews

★ Directly addresses AI governance and responsible deployment of advanced AI capabilities in regulated biosecurity contexts—a critical enterprise governance challenge Cristiano faces at Eidosmedia

A coalition of AI leaders including CEOs from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, and Microsoft submitted a letter to U.S. Congress on June 15 calling for mandatory screening of synthetic DNA and RNA orders to prevent misuse. The signatories argue that advances in AI are lowering the technical barriers for bad actors to weaponize biological materials, making legislative safeguards necessary.
